anomalies.description: A dark SUV on the left side of the road loses control, slides sideways across the intersection, and collides with a stationary or slow-moving vehicle near the center of the intersection. The impact is visible in frames f3–f5, with the SUV rotating and coming to rest angled across the lane.

A dark SUV enters the intersection from the right and collides with a black sedan traveling straight through the intersection; the impact occurs around 9.5–10.0 s, causing the sedan to rotate sharply leftward.

A second collision occurs: a dark SUV entering from the right (visible at f10) turns sharply left and strikes the front-left side of a black sedan moving straight through the intersection. The impact causes the sedan to swerve and the SUV to rotate, visible in frames f11–f12.
A dark-colored vehicle is overturned on the left shoulder of a snow-covered road, indicating a prior crash; it remains stationary throughout the sequence.

A large truck with a blue container overtakes the dashcam vehicle and appears to make contact or come extremely close to a smaller vehicle ahead in the same lane, suggesting a near-collision or minor collision event.
A white SUV attempts to overtake a yellow truck on a snowy two-lane road and collides with the truck's left side, causing the SUV to be pushed sideways off the road.
Vehicle collision occurs: bright flash and sudden loss of forward view indicate impact with oncoming vehicle; subsequent frames show darkness and smoke/debris.

Severe vehicle collision aftermath: a black SUV (identified as VAZ) is torn into two major sections lying in snow, with extensive deformation and exposed internal components; a second damaged vehicle (Toyota Land Cruiser) is visible nearby. Scene is illuminated by emergency lights at night.
